current_goal.goal: Show Video in the existing model-card capabilities checklist for Volcengine Ark and Agent Plan only, without changing foreign provider cards.
non_goals: Do not infer that every Volcengine-served model supports video.
Do not mutate AstrBot shared schema or static assets on disk.
Do not prevent Provider registration when the optional Dashboard asset boundary is unavailable.
Do not replace AstrBot routing, fallback, retry, provider lifecycle, or media ownership.
success_conditions: Ark and Agent Plan dialogs show video in the existing modalities checklist.
Foreign provider dialogs retain the original modalities options and no Volcengine-only rows.
Checking and unchecking video saves canonical modalities and matching runtime transport intent.
The exact minimal runtime package passes repository gates and the AstrBot native updater path.
A real marketplace update on the approved desktop AstrBot instance loads cleanly after a full Launcher restart.

frozen_constraints: AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, fallback, retry, model-card management, and the shared Dashboard schema.
The plugin may adapt only a verified private model-dialog schema clone that already has the selected Source type.
The video checklist value is explicit user transport configuration, not a model capability inference.
Foreign provider schemas and cards must remain unchanged by the Volcengine extension.
Unknown Dashboard assets degrade to the original UI without blocking Provider registration.
Historical QQ media evidence remains valid unless a REGRESSION_SCOPE invalidator fires.
Development documentation and evidence stay outside the allow-list runtime package.
